main_text.head: LXI.
Epistola Quinta.
ILLUSTRISSIME PRINCEPS.
main_text.p: OBsignatis prioribus meis litteris perlatum est ad me Imperialis mandati ad Bavaricum Ducem exemplum, ex quo suspicari licet, insidias vitæ meæ strui, quæ in re non civilia tantum,sed & Divina & Gentium jura violari constat, cum earum Serenissimi Regis Navarrensis jussu personam hactenus sustinuerim, quæ sacra & ab omni injuria tutissima esse debeat, me præsertim adversus Imperii pacem nihil omnino moliente, ut Illustriss. Celsitudo V. judicare potuit exiis scriptis, quæ Serenissimi Regis sententiam, aperte & sine fuco continent.
Quæ cum ita sint, exemplum illud ad Celsitudinem V. mittere volui, partim ut quid hac in re me facere statuat

page.notes: Catchword "statuat" printed at the foot right; the text at the foot is partly damaged, with stains at the left margin. Ornamental initial O is a large woodcut letter joined to "Bsignatis". Some words are in heavy black letter or with worn type, read with [?] where uncertain.
